purpose: Bounded placement/source-keypoint comparison, not a policy or continuous motion evaluation
reference_attribution: Copyright2026 Wuji Technology Co., Ltd.; see docs/sim2real/third-party/wuji/

protocol.source_robot_point_method: Original raw WUJI XML FK and explicit tip sites; all link_pos_w checked; no external Python control code executed or source joint angles copied to ORCA

source_robot_fk.point_mapping: wrist; per digit: proximal origin, middle origin, distal origin, model tip site

limitations: Synthetic at-rest initialization and constant nominal position targets; no ordinary reset, randomization, visual feedback, approach or dynamic replay.
Downward placements introduce some >2mm intersections and are diagnostic counterfactuals, not reset assets.
Robot-site point fitting changes scale and hand alignment as well as point targets; it is a pipeline comparison, not an isolated causal test of fingertip choice.
No new actor, formal gate, training budget, task controller, printable geometry or hardware action.
